value.text: The belfry? I ferry no strangers over that water. Light the sunken shrine, west to east, and we will talk. Or patch the old punt yourself; it wants pitch from an oil flask.
You lit the old shrine. My mother tended it. I owe you a crossing.
The black water is calm tonight.
I will be here. The water is patient.
Odd poles you across the black water to the drowned belfry.
